newsitem.title: USA: Banco de Galicia to start rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Galicia to start rights offer.

text.p: Banco de Galicia y Buenos Aires SA said on Monday it would commence a rights offering to existing shareholders to subscribe for a total of 35 million Ordinary B shares.
The rights would give each shareholder of record on October 16 the right to subscribe to 7.308 Ordinary B shares or ADS for each Ordinary B share or ADS held, it said.

The bank said it would begin the offer on October 17 and the subcription price would be established on or around October 29. The initial reference price for the rights offering was 5.122 pesetas per Ordinary B share and $20.488 per ADS, the bank said.
